model: constant explicit lumped C/g, nonnegative constant Q, constant Dirichlet, backward Euler

node_residual.accept: abs(r_i)<=1e-10*s_i+b_i AND b_i<=1e-6*s_i for active rows; no dimensional atol
node_residual.inactive_exact: s_i==0 requires r_i==0 and proposed increment==0; assign b_i=0 only for this exact inactive row
node_residual.fixed_rows: not free equilibrium errors; reservoir injection=sum_outward_q-Q

component_energy.components: positive-conductance undirected components, including singleton nodes
component_energy.rounding_bound_J: B_k=sum of active free-node b_i; fixed nodes have exactly zero increment
component_energy.accept: abs(R_k)<=1e-10*S_k+B_k and B_k<=1e-6*S_k; S_k==0 requires R_k==0 and B_k==0
component_energy.sums: math.fsum; component checks never share scales across disconnected components

representability.temperature: reconstruct Tnew from increment then recompute ALL physics from returned absolute temperatures; if nonzero proposed increment is lost entirely reject; if rounding budget exceeds local relative cap reject
representability.underflow: reject nonzero g and nonzero returned temperature drop producing zero q; reject nonzero C and represented nonzero increment producing zero energy; reject nonzero dt and nonzero q or Q producing zero step heat; reject nonfinite matrix, solve, temperature, flux, energy or scale; also reject positive dt*g underflow or overflow before assembly; reject nonzero driving products before exact-zero RHS shortcut
representability.zero_physics: zero-g edges exactly zero; exact zero RHS skips solve and keeps state; no clamps, regularization, grounding or inferred parameters

input_validation.ids: nonnegative int64, not bool; exact node/edge coverage; unknown/missing keys reject; duplicate conflicting boundary entries reject, equal duplicates coalesce
input_validation.values: C finite >0; g finite >=0; T0/fixed finite >=0 K; Q finite >=0; no temperature clipping
input_validation.fixed_initial: exact float64 equality required, no silent initial reset
input_validation.time: finite 1D float64 grid starts exactly 0, >=2 points, strictly increasing; abs(diff-dt)<=32*eps64*max(abs(time_end),dt); actual each interval used, refactor if interval differs; no silently rounded requested timestamps

failure.numerical: ThermalSolveError with detached last-accepted result prefix, attempted step/time and diagnostic reason; invalid trial arrays never in accepted prefix
failure.t0: temperature and instantaneous edge rates available; interval residual/energy balance unavailable: NaN plus explicit availability mask false
failure.json: NaN array diagnostics serialize only as null plus availability mask, strict JSON allow_nan=false

time_reference_gates.continuous_and_BE_discrete_references: separate; discrete match alone cannot pass continuum gate

reported_tolerance: relative algebraic term 1e-10 plus explicit representation allowance capped at 1e-6 of local scale; never advertise total acceptance as 1e-10 alone
